answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an AI-agent network can require bonded economic staking. Whether monitoring an orange grove or auditing carved ivory, each agent must escrow digital assets to broadcast a valid operational signal. An attacker incurs the scarce cost of locking real capital per identity, which is slashed if duplicate or malicious actions occur. However, this model biases network influence toward wealthy cartels and bars capital-constrained micro-agents.
